raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Paris < Latin Lutetia Parisiorum; Parisii < Gaulish *pario- 'cauldron' or *paris 'working man'",
    "reading": "The cauldron-people, those who boil or forge; a place of transformation and craft.",
    "languages": ["la", "cel", "fr"],
    "source": "Delamarre, Dictionnaire de la langue gauloise",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Par + is; par (Fr) = by/through; is (en) = third person singular of 'to be'",
    "reading": "That which is through being; existence as passage, a threshold of becoming.",
    "languages": ["fr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Paris ~ paris (Fr) = pari 'bet' (homophone); ~ parvis (Fr) = church forecourt",
    "reading": "A sacred wager before the temple; the threshold where one stakes one's soul.",
    "languages": ["fr", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Paris -> ripa (Latin) = riverbank; -> pairs (en) = couples",
    "reading": "The riverbank of paired opposites; where two shores meet and become one.",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "P-A-R-I-S: Porta, Aether, Rota, Ignis, Sal (Latin) = gate, sky, wheel, fire, salt",
    "reading": "Gate of the sky, wheel of fire and salt; an alchemical portal of elements.",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "P (Greek rho) = breath; A = alpha, beginning; R = rotation; I = self; S = serpent",
    "reading": "Breath begins the turning self, serpent-wise; the spiral of conscious life.",
    "languages": ["grc", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "P=80, A=1, R=80, I=9, S=90 (Greek isopsephy) sum=260; 260 = 2*130 = 2*(5*26)",
    "reading": "Twofold completion of the alphabet's heart; a double cycle of hidden order.",
    "languages": ["grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Paris < Old French Paris < Latin Parisii; possibly from *pari- 'ship' (cf. Greek paros 'sailor')",
    "reading": "The sailors' town; a harbour of arrival and departure, a crossing of waters.",
    "languages": ["la", "grc"],
    "source": "Ernout-Meillet, Dictionnaire étymologique de la langue latine",
    "confidence": 0.4
  }
]
